errors.registerType: This capability cannot use that register table
errors.writeRegisterType: A write binding must use a coil or holding register
errors.tooManyTotal: A device can have at most {max} points ({free} more can be added)
errors.bitTableBool: Coils and discrete inputs use the bool data type
errors.bitRange: The bit must be a whole number from 0 to 15
errors.beyondAddressSpace: This runs past the last address (65535)
errors.valueMapFloat: A value map cannot be used with float32
errors.valueMapScaled: A value map cannot be combined with a scale or an offset
errors.valueMapRaw: Every value map entry needs a raw number
errors.valueMapRawRange: Raw values must be whole numbers this data type can hold (0 or 1 for a coil, discrete input or bit)
errors.valueMapRawUnique: Each raw value can appear only once in the value map
errors.valueMapValueUnique: Each value can appear only once in the value map
errors.valueMapInvert: Invert cannot be combined with a value map; express the inversion in the map
errors.singleWrite32: A 32-bit value spans two registers and needs the multiple write function
errors.longPressRange: The long press time must be a whole number from 100 to 10000 ms
errors.longPressNotButton: A long press time applies to the read binding of a button event only
errors.buttonLevel: A button reads a boolean level: use a coil, a discrete input or a register bit
errors.buttonValueMap: A button reads a boolean level and takes no value map; use invert to flip it
errors.numberBool: A numeric value cannot be read as bool unless a bit is set
errors.scaleZero: The scale cannot be 0, it would turn every value into 0
